rows.text: "A Sage must wear a beard!" No one knows which Sage from the Grove of Epiphany first proposed this idea, but it quickly gained enthusiastic support. Soon, Sages were adorning their sparse chins with gathered twigs and leaves. That meeting of the Sages ended in joyous laughter, and the robes made from branches and leaves became their official attire. It is said that under Cerces's witness, these robes would sprout new leaves as wisdom grows, just like a beard would.
